line.en: A Chinese handscroll of rice paper unrolled from the right.

for.en: Chinese history and culture unrolled as a hand scroll: dynasties, journeys, lives, for Chinese narration.
for.zh-CN: 像长卷一样展开的中国历史与文化：朝代、旅程、人物生平，为中文旁白设计。

not.en: Modern data and technology; films in other languages than Chinese.
not.zh-CN: 现代数据与科技；非中文的影片。
